# Date Picker

```tsx
import { DatePicker } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para selecionar uma data ou intervalo de datas.

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Input Date and Input Date Range components: an Input Text typed as DD/MM/AAAA, with Button Clear and an Action Inset (Calendar icon) that opens the Date Picker panel (Calendar in a Popover) below the field. Type picks a Day, Month or Year (the panel opens on that grid); Range=True is the Input Date Range, two fields sharing the two-month panel. Show Footer adds Cancelar / Aplicar: the panel then keeps a draft that only Aplicar commits. Without it, picking a date commits and closes.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`DateFieldProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Icon: the leading Calendar icon. |

`DateField`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `React.ReactNode` | The calendar button: a `PopoverPrimitive.Trigger`. |

`DatePickerCommonProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobile?` | `boolean` | Figma Mobile=True: the panel opens as a Bottom Sheet. |
| `showFooter?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Footer: Cancelar / Aplicar under the calendar. |
| `resetLabel?` | `React.ReactNode` | Mobile only: the ghost action that clears the picked date. |
| `cancelLabel?` | `React.ReactNode` | "Cancelar" by default, "Voltar" on mobile. |
| `calendarLabel?` | `string` | Accessible name of the calendar button. |
| `calendarProps?` | `Omit< CalendarProps, "range" \| "selected" \| "onSelect" \| "type" \| "onPeriodSelect" \| "mobile" >` | Extra Calendar props: `disabledDays`, `startMonth`, `endMonth`… |

`DatePickerSingleProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `range?` | `false` | Figma Range=False: one field. |
| `type?` | `DatePickerType` | Figma Type: what the field holds and the grid the panel opens on. |

`DatePickerRangeProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | `true` | Figma Range=True: Data inicial and Data final with a two-month panel. |
| `type?` | `"day"` | Range picks days only. |
| `endLabel?` | `React.ReactNode` | `label`, `error`, `helpText` and `name` go to Data inicial; these to Data final. |

## Rules

- Import `DatePicker` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
